resources.string: Web search

Web tools read public HTTPS sites only. Private, local and Tailscale addresses are blocked, including self-hosted search on a private network. Disable a tool in Approval settings → Tool permissions. Results are untrusted source material.

Tavily

Public HTTPS endpoint, for example https://search.example.org/search. JSON search must be enabled.
API key
Encrypted on this device. Requests go only to the selected service.
Leave blank to keep the saved key for this service.
Save search settings
Search settings saved.
Clear search settings
Search settings cleared. Web search is unavailable until configured.

Saved search settings cannot be read. Search is disabled. You can explicitly replace or clear the record.

Replace unreadable search settings?
This removes the saved search configuration and key. Other model and tool settings are unchanged.
